notes.title: Halloween Update (Version 1.0.5)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28845777/2af5fb01bbef9f7ccf85b016d6c270cfbd80c80d.png[/img]

Hi Terries!

To celebrate Halloween –– and the Day of the Dead –– we have updated Necrosphere to allow all players access to the bonus level. We hope you enjoy this devious nightmare. 

[h1]Halloween Sale[/h1]
[list][*]A special [b]25% OFF[/b] Halloween Sale for new players![/list]

[h1]Version 1.0.5[/h1]
[*]A FREE update to the Deluxe version that unlocks [b]Terry's Dream Bonus Level[/b]!
[*]For those interested, the DLC contains [b]Necrosphere's Original Soundtrack[/b] by Juliane Andrezzo. We appreciate your support![/list]

[h1]Terry's Dream (Bonus Level)[/h1]

While inside the Necrosphere, agent Terry Cooper has a lucid dream that removes everything he has gathered so far –– even his clothes.

[list][*]Collect 5 DVDs to unlock this bonus level at the Main Screen.
[*]Progress is not saved while within Terry's Dream. Muahahaha...[/list]

Don't forget to let us know what you think in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/607400/discussions/]discussions page[/url]!

notes.title: Necrosphere 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Terries! Today we've pushed live some bug fixes to help ensure you can escape the afterlife more comfortably. Please keep the feedback coming in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/607400/discussions/]discussions
 page[/url], we love it.

[h1]Terry's Dream (Deluxe only):[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bad placed camera trigger
    [*]Added quick fix to red screen bug on Terry's Dream (Available on the [b]F1[/b] Help Menu)
[/list]
[h1]Final Zone:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Improved autosave near the final portal
[/list]
[h1]Purple zone:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed two dead-ends
[/list]
[h1]Chore:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Updated ending credits
[/list]

[b]Thanks for playing![/b]

[i]Edit: We jumped the version 1.0.2 because it was a broken build that we wrongly pushed live. We're sorry if you tried to play it for the 40 minutes range that it was available.[/i]

notes.title: Wot I Think: Two-button metroidvania Necrosphere
notes.content: I am completely and totally in love with platformer Necrosphere [official site]. I have also shouted at it so much that I now genuinely have a sore throat. I cannot remember a time when I’ve improved so, so much at a game in a relatively short space of time, to the point where completing certain sections has had me begin to imagine statues built in my honour. And then I come crashing down to Earth as I struggle with the very next moment. It’s a complete joy, a full 2D Metroidvania, and yet the whole game is controlled with only two buttons. (more…)

notes.title: Necrosphere 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there! Thanks for playing Necrosphere, I hope you are enjoying it. Today we've came up with some bugfixes and added a help menu with some requested features that can be accessed by pressing [b]F1[/b] ingame.

[h1]Help Menu (F1):[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Mute Sound
    [*]Stop Audio Playback (gets rid of music)
    [*]Frameskip On/Off (select ON on slow computers)
    [*]Fullscreen/Windowed support
[/list]
[h1]Purple Zone:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Changed a spike to fireball in a specific area to avoid getting Terry stuck
[/list]
[h1]Achievements:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fix Dreamcatcher
    [*]Fix OCD
[/list]

notes.title: Necrontroller Challenge
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28845777/4bb6f48611259e6449dc4d61c090fb74cfa93857.jpg[/img]

The player that finishes the game in fastest time wins a Limited Edition Necrontroller like the ones above.

To compete, players must post to our Necrosphere’s Facebook Page one of the following:
- Link to the video containing the main game speed-run with a marked timer on screen.
- Image or video showing the time marked at the game’s ending credits (like the video below).

[i]The main game consists of the five different areas available in the Standard and the Deluxe version. The free Demo and Terry's Dream bonus level are not part of this competition.[/i]

The deadline is September 30th, 2017 23:59 BRT (Brazilian Time. That's GMT -3 hours). If there’s a draw, wins the player that posted earlier in the timeline. On October 1st, 2017 we'll announce the winner, ask for a contact email, and then get the details to ship the controller to the informed address (shipment costs on us).
 
Try Harder and Good Luck!

For more info, visit the following link: http://www.catnigiri.com/necrosphere/necrontroller-challenge/
